content: Open-Meteo Archive API https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive takes latitude,longitude,start_date,end_date,hourly=temperature_2m,wind_speed_10m,wind_direction_10m,shortwave_radiation,relative_humidity_2m, wind_speed_unit=ms, timezone=UTC. Returns JSON with hourly.time array (no explicit UTC suffix even in UTC mode) and per-variable arrays. Data from 1940-present, ERA5 reanalysis. Live-confirmed against Austin coordinates.
